e.title: HKMC（香港按揭证券公司）：公共年金、逆按揭与每月计划统计
e.title_en: HKMC (The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation): the public annuity, reverse mortgages and monthly programme statistics
e.title_hk: HKMC（香港按揭證券公司）：公共年金、逆按揭與每月計劃統計
e.summary: 港府全资机构：公共年金与逆按揭计划的运营方，按月发布按揭保险、逆按揭与中小企融资担保计划的统计 PDF
e.summary_en: A wholly government-owned institution: operator of the public annuity and reverse mortgage schemes, publishing monthly statistics PDFs for mortgage insurance, reverse mortgages and the SME financing guarantee scheme
e.summary_hk: 港府全資機構：公共年金與逆按揭計劃的運營方，按月發布按揭保險、逆按揭與中小企融資擔保計劃的統計 PDF
e.body:
**HKMC（The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation，香港按揭证券公司）** 是**香港政府全资拥有的机构**，也是**香港退休与住房相关金融产品的实际运营方**。本条目属本轮「**区域形态缺口**」取向：实测池内**HKMC 相关条目为 0**（香港条目已覆盖保监局统计、积金局平台、保险投诉局、保险业联会、VHIS 等，但**「公共年金 / 逆按揭 / 按揭保险」这一支完全缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 57.2KB；业务页实测含 **Reverse Mortgage Programme（逆按揭计划）** 与 **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme（保单逆按揭计划）**；信息中心实测含 **Annual Reports（年报页 80.8KB）** 与 **Publications / e-Publications**，新闻实测含 **2026-08-28「HKMC’s Social Bonds Allocation Update」** 与 **2026-08-24「HKMCA Introduces Cross-Boundary Annuity Disbu…」（跨境年金发放）**。⭐ **最关键的是按月发布的计划统计 PDF，本次逐个实测可下载**：**按揭保险计划统计 2026 年 8 月**（`mip_statistics_2026-08.pdf`，HTTP 200、24.8KB、`application/pdf`）、**逆按揭计划统计 2026 年 8 月**（`RM statistics_ENG_Aug 2026.pdf`，HTTP 200、103.5KB、`application/pdf`）、**中小企融资担保计划统计 2026 年 7 月**（`SFGS Statistics_Eng_20260710.pdf`）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上香港退休产品与长寿风险这一支**——池内香港条目偏**监管统计**（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]）、**公积金平台**（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）与**消费者保护**（[[hk-icb]]、[[hkfi]]），而**「公共年金如何定价与运营、逆按揭把房产换成终身收入的机制」此前没有入口**；HKMC 的**每月逆按揭统计**（笔数、金额、年龄结构）正是**长寿风险与住房资产年金化**研究的**本地一手数据**，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 并读；**② 「按揭保险」是一个常被忽略的险种**——池内信用/保证类条目（[[payout-assurance-standard]] 等）多为参数险或债权口径，而**按揭保险**是**信贷风险向保险转移**的典型安排，HKMC 的**月度按揭保险统计**给出了这个险种在香港的实际规模；**③ 政策侧信号**——新闻中的**跨境年金发放**（2026-08）与**社会债券资金分配**，对关注**大湾区养老金融**的学生是本地政策观察点。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面结构、三个统计 PDF 与年报页的具体链接（均实测可下载/可访问）**，**但未打开 PDF 正文**，因此**不能确认统计口径与覆盖范围**；**②** **公共年金计划本身由独立实体「HKMC Annuity Limited」运营**——本次实测 `hkmca.com.hk` **连接失败（000）**，其站点**无法核实**，故词条**只写 HKMC 本体，不替其年金子公司背书**；**③** HKMC 官网未见 `annuity` 路径（实测 **404**），**年金相关内容需以官方另行发布的材料为准**；**④** 三个统计为**按月发布**，**历史期次未逐一验证**。**核实说明**：首页（57.2KB）、年报页（80.8KB）、两个统计 PDF（24.8KB / 103.5KB，均 `application/pdf`）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开 PDF 正文**。
e.body_en:
**HKMC (The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation)** is a **wholly Hong Kong government-owned institution** and the **actual operator of Hong Kong’s retirement- and housing-related financial products**. This entry follows this round’s "**regional form gap**" approach: a measured search found **zero HKMC-related entries** (Hong Kong coverage already includes regulator statistics, the MPF platform, the Insurance Complaints Bureau, the Federation of Insurers and VHIS, but the **"public annuity / reverse mortgage / mortgage insurance" strand was entirely missing**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is 57.2KB; business pages include the **Reverse Mortgage Programme** and the **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme**; the information centre includes **Annual Reports (page 80.8KB)** and **Publications / e-Publications**, and the news items include **"HKMC’s Social Bonds Allocation Update" of 2026-08-28** and **"HKMCA Introduces Cross-Boundary Annuity Disbu…" of 2026-08-24**. ⭐ **Most important are the monthly programme statistics PDFs, each measured as downloadable**: **Mortgage Insurance Programme Statistics for August 2026** (`mip_statistics_2026-08.pdf`, HTTP 200, 24.8KB, `application/pdf`), **Reverse Mortgage Programme Statistics for August 2026** (`RM statistics_ENG_Aug 2026.pdf`, HTTP 200, 103.5KB, `application/pdf`) and **SME Financing Guarantee Scheme statistics for July 2026** (`SFGS Statistics_Eng_20260710.pdf`).

For RIAA: **① it adds Hong Kong’s retirement products and longevity risk strand** — existing Hong Kong entries lean on **regulatory statistics** ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[hk-censtatd-insurance]]), the **MPF platform** ([[mpf-fund-platform]], [[mpfa]], [[mpfe]]) and **consumer protection** ([[hk-icb]], [[hkfi]]), while **"how a public annuity is priced and operated, and how a reverse mortgage turns property into lifetime income" had no entry point**; HKMC’s **monthly reverse mortgage statistics** (case counts, amounts, age structure) are **local primary data for research on longevity risk and the annuitisation of housing wealth**, readable with [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[lifeinsurer]], [[open-life-au]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]. **② Mortgage insurance is frequently overlooked** — credit- and guarantee-type entries in the corpus (such as [[payout-assurance-standard]]) are mostly parametric or debt instruments, whereas **mortgage insurance** is the classic arrangement transferring **credit risk to insurance**, and HKMC’s **monthly mortgage insurance statistics** document that line’s actual scale in Hong Kong. **③ Policy signals** — the **cross-boundary annuity** news (August 2026) and the **social bond allocation update** are local observation points for students following **Greater Bay Area retirement finance**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the page structure and the specific links to three statistics PDFs and the annual reports page (all measured reachable/downloadable)**, **but opened no PDF**, so **definitions and coverage cannot be confirmed**; **②** **the public annuity scheme itself is operated by a separate entity, HKMC Annuity Limited** — `hkmca.com.hk` measured a **failed connection (000)**, so **its site could not be verified**, and this entry **covers the HKMC parent only and does not vouch for its annuity subsidiary**; **③** no `annuity` path exists on the HKMC site (measured **404**), so **annuity material must come from official publications elsewhere**; **④** the three statistics are published **monthly** and **earlier periods were not verified individually**. **Verification note**: the homepage (57.2KB), the annual reports page (80.8KB) and the two statistics PDFs (24.8KB / 103.5KB, both `application/pdf`) were measured at HTTP 200; **no PDF body was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**HKMC（The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation，香港按揭證券公司）** 是**香港政府全資擁有的機構**，也是**香港退休與住房相關金融產品的實際運營方**。本條目屬本輪「**區域形態缺口**」取向：實測池內**HKMC 相關條目為 0**（香港條目已覆蓋監管統計、積金局平台、保險投訴局、保險業聯會、VHIS 等，但**「公共年金／逆按揭／按揭保險」這一支完全缺位**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 57.2KB；業務頁實測含 **Reverse Mortgage Programme（逆按揭計劃）** 與 **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme（保單逆按揭計劃）**；信息中心實測含 **Annual Reports（年報頁 80.8KB）** 與 **Publications / e-Publications**，新聞實測含 **2026-08-28 社會債券資金分配更新** 與 **2026-08-24「跨境年金發放」**。⭐ **最關鍵的是按月發布的計劃統計 PDF，本次逐個實測可下載**：**按揭保險計劃統計 2026 年 8 月**（HTTP 200、24.8KB、`application/pdf`）、**逆按揭計劃統計 2026 年 8 月**（HTTP 200、103.5KB、`application/pdf`）、**中小企融資擔保計劃統計 2026 年 7 月**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上香港退休產品與長壽風險這一支**——池內香港條目偏**監管統計**（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]）、**公積金平台**（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）與**消費者保護**（[[hk-icb]]、[[hkfi]]），而**「公共年金如何定價與運營、逆按揭把房產換成終身收入的機制」此前沒有入口**；HKMC 的**每月逆按揭統計**正是**長壽風險與住房資產年金化**研究的**本地一手數據**，可與 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 並讀；**② 「按揭保險」是常被忽略的險種**——**按揭保險**是**信貸風險向保險轉移**的典型安排，HKMC 的**月度按揭保險統計**給出該險種在香港的實際規模；**③ 政策側信號**——**跨境年金發放**（2026-08）與社會債券資金分配，是**大灣區養老金融**的本地觀察點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面結構與三個統計 PDF 及年報頁的具體鏈接（均實測可下載/可訪問）**，**但未打開 PDF 正文**；**② 公共年金計劃本身由獨立實體「HKMC Annuity Limited」運營**——本次實測 `hkmca.com.hk` **連接失敗（000）**，其站點**無法核實**，故詞條**只寫 HKMC 本體**；**③** HKMC 官網未見 `annuity` 路徑（實測 **404**）；**④** 統計為**按月發布**，**歷史期次未逐一驗證**。**核實說明**：首頁、年報頁、兩個統計 PDF 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開 PDF 正文**。
